column1: # Spectral Line Wiki -- optical night-sky (airglow) emission lines
# Observed lines: Hanuschik R.W. 2003
#   CDS/VizieR J/A+A/407/1157 tables 4-9 (doi:10.26093/cds/vizier.34071157
#   plus lines present only in the later ESO QC web line tables (gident_*.dat
# wl_air_A: verbatim source string
column2: air wavelength (UVES ThAr-calibrated pipeline scale). CDS strings have 4 decimals;

column1: #   ESO-web-only rows keep the ESO .dat string (6 decimals printed from FITS float32 -> digits beyond ~1e-3 A are not significant).
# uncert_A: 0.017 = author-stated likely error of a single line position (Hanuschik 2003 sect. 5.2: UVES-Keck <d> = +8 +- 17 mA
#   N=529 lines >5200 A). Internal dispersion-solution rms 0.0047 A (346 nm setting) to 0.010 A (860 nm setting).
#   Known systematic: UVES - NIST = +0.0013 +- 0.0002 nm for 13 atomic lines (Cosby et al. 2006 Table 5); UVES - HIRES +0.00116 nm.
# flux: verbatim FLUX column = Gaussian-fit central (peak) flux density INCLUDING the local continuum
#   unit 1e-16 erg s-1 cm-2 A-1 arcsec-2 (ESO QC page; VizieR lists 1e-16 erg/s/cm2/A)
# flux_peak_R_per_nm_derived: flux converted to Rayleigh/nm (derived; R/nm = F*1e-16*lambda/(hc)*206264.806^2*4pi*1e-6*10).
# fwhm_A: verbatim FWHM of the fitted Gaussian (A). R ~ 43000-45000 (1 arcsec slit).
# wl_vac_A: blank (not given by the source). wl_vac_A_derived: DERIVED from wl_air_A with Edlen (1966) as printed in
#   Hanuschik 2003 eq. 5
# ident: DERIVED identification (NOT the Cosby et al. 2006 published list
column2: whose machine-readable supplement could not be

column1: #   retrieved). Each line was cross-matched to the PALACE v1.0 model line list (Noll et al. 2025
#   doi:10.5281/zenodo.14064023; positions from HITRAN2020 for OH and O2 b-X/a-X
#   NIST for atoms; vacuum -> air with Edlen 1966) using the Cosby+2006 criterion |lam_obs-lam_model| < 0.5*max(lam/40000
#   model intensity weighted by PALACE Paranal transmission
column2: I*T >= 1e-3 R. Labels (after Cosby+2006): S1 single (or >=5x dominant);

column1: #   L2 OH Lambda doublet pair; B2 two transitions within a factor 3; Mn n blended transitions (each >=10% of the total
#   U no model line in window; suffix w = assigned model intensity <0.1 x rough observed intensity (tentative).
#   OH labels: band v'-v''
#   O2 labels: system(v'-v'') branch DeltaN DeltaJ F'F'' (N''). ident_model_wl_air_A = mean model air wavelength of the strongest unit.
# hires_*: Keck/HIRES lines (Osterbrock et al. 1996 PASP 108
column3: 614; VizieR III/211) within the same window;
